changes: Heater lead bends stay above the deck until beyond the casting edge; buried rings replaced by surface-mounted saddles.
Lower carriage and crossed straps fit the opening throughout reconstructed travel.
Handle travel and 8:1 tool output limits share one clearance-derived envelope.
inspected_pairs: Carriage/crossed straps vs cavity side, rear, floor and roof skin planes
Lever/ferrule/ball vs deck, casting and pedestal over continuous full travel
scope: Evaluated Blender source vertices give exact translated extrema for the Cartesian handle mechanism; 27 domain corners/midpoints characterize the box domain. Each handle/ball face is also expanded over the complete continuous XYZ domain and checked against conservative detailed deck/casting/pedestal bounds. Actual lead triangles are checked against these surfaces via BVH. The aperture is a conservative skin-plane envelope; service lead contact with its dedicated saddle is intentional.
exclusions: Intended contact within concealed carriage bearings and crossing-link pivot stacks.
Bond wedge/sample contact and mechanically seated fasteners and saddle mounting feet.
This Cartesian surrogate is not a factory four-bar reconstruction.
limitation: The envelope is measured from the reconstructed model; it is not a manufacturer travel specification. Internal transmission remains the documented equivalent Cartesian 8:1 mechanism.
